note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation in this sermon was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS New Testament wording and the Old Testament wording the first translation carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, verses joined, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; a verbatim recitation without quote marks counts (founder rule, 2026-11-19). `self_rendered` rows each carry a `why`: allusions left in Wesley's prose and his own paraphrases.

The same sermon is chapter 3 of Sermons on Several Occasions, whose Amharic shares this translation's base text; it was re-quoted first (PR #9908), and this sermon follows its OWB wording and its calls quotation for quotation, so the two stay identical (the sermon keeps only its own opening: the text verse as a blockquote, without the book's chapter heading and Agrippa sentence). Calls carried over: 'Almost thou persuadest me' is OWB Acts 26:28 «በዚህ በአጭር ጊዜ ክርስቲያን እንድሆን ልታሳምነኝ ነው!»; the Name proclaimed to Moses is Exod 34:6-7 (not Ps 86:15) and 'make all his goodness pass before thee' Exod 33:19; Luke 1:47, Isa 26:8 and Gal 6:14 are quoted with their speakers (Mary, the prophet, the apostle) named in the prose; 1 Cor 13:4-7 follows OWB's wording throughout (Wesley's 'is not puffed up' = «በትዕቢት አይነፋም»).
